02 / HOW TO SURVIVE✦
  1. Watch the gems.Each column belongs to a bandmate. Hits damage the enemy.
  2. Meet the beat.Use D / F with your left hand, J / K with your right. Hit as the gem reaches its keycap. On mobile, tap it.
  3. Keep it going.Misses and off-beat taps cost health. Choose a relic and a route after each victory.
